"from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Load the workbook
wb = load_workbook('ssb_341_40_init.xlsx')

# Get the Sheet1
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Iterate through rows and apply the condition
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    a_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    b_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    c_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value
    
    # Check if all three conditions are met
    if a_val == 'Government' and b_val == 'Germany' and c_val == 'Carretera':
        # Insert 'Volkswagen' into column Q (column 17)
        ws.cell(row=row, column=17).value = 'Volkswagen'

# Save the workbook
wb.save('output.xlsx')"
